essential.label: Deformed image (with sphere)
essential.description: 3D TIFF stack captured with the indenter pressing into the sample

essential.label: Reference image (without sphere)
essential.description: 3D TIFF stack of the undeformed sample (no indenter)

essential.label: Output folder
essential.description: Directory where Ux/Uy/Uz displacement fields and metadata are saved

essential.label: Tracking method
essential.description: Algorithm used to reconstruct the 3D displacement field

essential.label: Voxel size XY
essential.description: Physical pixel spacing in X and Y directions (synced with Step 1)

essential.label: Voxel size Z
essential.description: Physical spacing between Z slices (synced with Step 1)

essential.label: Sphere diameter
essential.description: Indenter / calibration sphere diameter (synced with Step 1)

advanced.label: Image downsample (XY)
advanced.description: Factor to reduce input image resolution in X/Y before optimization

advanced.label: Image downsample (Z)
advanced.description: Factor to reduce input image resolution in Z before optimization

advanced.label: Z crop start
advanced.description: First Z-slice index to include (0-based). Use to discard top slices.

advanced.label: Z crop end (exclusive)
advanced.description: Last Z-slice index (exclusive). Leave empty to include all slices.

advanced.label: Device
advanced.description: Hardware for optimization: auto detects GPU if available

advanced.label: Output downsample (XY)
advanced.description: Downsample final displacement field in X/Y before saving (1 = full resolution)

advanced.label: Output downsample (Z)
advanced.description: Downsample final displacement field in Z before saving (1 = full resolution)

advanced.label: Upsample interpolation order
advanced.description: Interpolation method when upsampling coarse deformation to full resolution

advanced.label: Output smoothing
advanced.description: Post-processing filter applied to final Ux/Uy/Uz fields

advanced.label: Smoothing strength
advanced.description: Sigma for Gaussian, or diffusion strength for Laplacian (typical 0.5–5.0)

advanced.label: LR: global shift
advanced.description: Learning rate for the global rigid-body translation

advanced.label: LR: rotation axis
advanced.description: Learning rate for rotation axis direction

advanced.label: LR: rotation angle
advanced.description: Learning rate for rotation angle magnitude

advanced.label: LR: deformation
advanced.description: Learning rate for the local deformation field

advanced.label: Iterations
advanced.description: Total number of optimization iterations

advanced.label: Batch size
advanced.description: Random voxels sampled per iteration (higher = more stable, slower)

advanced.label: TV² regularization
advanced.description: Smoothness penalty on deformation field (0 = off, higher = smoother)

advanced.label: Deformation downsample (XY)
advanced.description: Coarse grid factor in X/Y for deformation field (higher = fewer DOFs)

advanced.label: Deformation downsample (Z)
advanced.description: Coarse grid factor in Z for deformation field

advanced.label: Lock global shift
advanced.description: Freeze the global rigid-body translation after initial estimate

advanced.label: Uz penalty weight
advanced.description: 0 = off. >0 adds penalty on upward internal Uz in the coarse field (stronger = more downward bias in saved Uz).

advanced.label: Progress interval
advanced.description: Report progress to UI every N iterations

essential.label: Model path
essential.description: Path to a pre-trained ML model checkpoint

advanced.label: Confidence threshold
advanced.description: Minimum prediction confidence to accept (0–1)

essential.label: Training epochs
essential.description: Number of full passes through the training data

advanced.label: Learning rate
advanced.description: Step size for the ML training optimizer

essential.label: Material model
essential.description: Constitutive model used to relate stress and strain

essential.label: VFM data folder
essential.description: Folder containing Ux/Uy/Uz.npy from the tracking step

essential.label: Applied force
essential.description: Indentation force applied by the sphere

essential.label: E1 initial guess
essential.description: Starting value for axial Young's modulus

essential.label: E2 initial guess
essential.description: Starting value for transverse Young's modulus

essential.label: Poisson ratio v12
essential.description: Poisson ratio in the 1-2 plane (axial-transverse)

essential.label: Poisson ratio v23
essential.description: Poisson ratio in the 2-3 plane (transverse-transverse)

essential.label: Shear modulus Gt
essential.description: Transverse shear modulus

essential.label: Mesh file (.inp)
essential.description: Optional .inp mesh file for precise L/W/H. If blank, computed from grids.

essential.label: C10 initial guess
essential.description: Isotropic ground matrix stiffness

essential.label: D1 initial guess
essential.description: Compressibility parameter (lower = more incompressible)

essential.label: Fiber stiffness k1
essential.description: Stiffness of embedded collagen fibers

essential.label: Fiber nonlinearity k2
essential.description: Exponential stiffening parameter for fibers

essential.label: Kappa initial guess
essential.description: Fiber dispersion (0 = perfectly aligned, 1/3 = isotropic)
